report: 2019/2019.08.01.Mobile_OceanLotus/Analysis of the Attack of Mobile Devices by OceanLotus

removed.reason: Only exfiltrates SMS, contacts, call records, location, and browser records; no OS/hardware system information discovery.
No spearphishing email or malicious attachment described.
Mentions uploading files to C2 and dynamically loading sub-packages, but no clear external tool/file transfer into the victim environment.
No SSH or remote login service described.
